admission.justification: Prevents converted review facts from citing transient worktree role-reports paths deleted at cleanup, and is proved by three test functions in mcp/tests/test_knowledge_state_conversion_verdict_ref.py.

applicability: Every archived passed memory review fact written by the one-time state conversion into knowledge/history/converted-reviews.json.
conditions: The archived task document names a non-empty verdict reference for its last passed memory review round.
Relative and absolute role-reports/<rel> or notes/reports/<rel> paths with non-empty, traversal-free relative tails normalize to notes/reports/<rel> by pure segment parsing without filesystem reads.
exclusions: Empty-tail paths, paths containing .. traversal segments, URLs, and non-report paths, which remain unchanged without inventing a path.
Ordinary closeout review facts written by worktrees/review_fact_source.py and shared usable_verdict_ref handling in tasks/route_review.py.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_knowledge_state_conversion_verdict_ref.py::test_review_fact_normalizes_report_verdict_refs, test_review_fact_leaves_invalid_or_non_report_refs_unchanged, test_plan_state_conversion_writes_durable_verdict_refs_in_converted_reviews (8 failed before -> 17 passed after, independently reproduced); Code Rounds 1-3 PASSED; synced code candidate tree 73fc8a8e0c82f15e600a68e696494c112faebdd9 over base 65911c75fbe4207e06e325dd50a6940f57330920 (D1036 cleared); authoritative conversion on base memory a53148f8 produces 62/62 durable notes/reports verdictRef entries with 0 role-reports, 0 worktrees, 0 absolute, and 0 missing on disk after 1-line L57 existing-path fix.

statement: The state conversion writes each archived review fact's verdict reference as the durable collected notes/reports/<rel> path and never as a worktree or absolute path, leaving invalid, empty-tail, traversal and non-report references unchanged.
title: State conversion stores durable notes/reports verdict references
